name: Oboth
overview: Oboth is identified in Scripture as one of the designated camping places of the children of Israel during their forty years of wilderness wandering. The book of Numbers records their journey as they pitched at Oboth before moving on to Ijeabarim, located near the border of Moab (Numbers 21:10-11; 33:43-44). These passages highlight Oboth's role as a specific stopover in the divinely guided progression of Israel toward the Promised Land.
